snippet.title: [ Within ]  A Narrative-driven Adventure Mobile Game Promotion Video [ 迴憶之間 ]
snippet.description:
"To truly define who you are, is to face the nightmare from within."

"Within" is a narrative-driven adventure mobile game with a focus on exploring your inner self.
We call for those who are fans of mobile games containing exploration and murky forlorn atmospheres to come follow Emma’s footsteps into this desolate fairytale world. Awaken your past secrets and retrieve the very definition of oneself.

★Android Beta Test 
Download at ▷ https://silvrlin.pse.is/KWCZV

★Your every word of feedback will be our invaluable asset.
Take the survey ▷https://thegamewithin.co/form/index.html

★Connect with Us
Website ▷https://thegamewithin.co
Facebook ▷https://www.facebook.com/silvrlin.within
Twitter ▷https://twitter.com/official_within

By Within Dev. Team

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

「唯有面對夢魘，才能真正定義自己。」

「迴憶之間」是一款和您一起探索內心世界為主題的冒險敘事遊戲。
在此召集喜愛手遊、暗黑風格和探索故事的你，跟隨艾瑪一起沈浸到戰慄的童話世界，喚醒自己曾經的秘密、找回自己的定義。

★Android Beta Test
